levels.name: Relic Runner 2

params.text: A relic glows atop the ridge...

hudElements.text: Reach the relic on the ridge!

startScreen.title: Relic Runner 2
startScreen.subtitle: Reach the amber ridge relic. Use the low ramp, keep clear of the guardian, and claim the high ground. Visual landmark: Runner gate.
startScreen.howToPlay:
Climb the ramp and claim the ridge relic.

WASD / arrows move; Space jumps; Q attacks; Escape pauses.
startScreen.credits: Original models, textures and sound by Digital Opus Engine. Animated traversal, ramps and checkpoint recovery.
startScreen.controlsHint: WASD / arrows move; Space jumps; Q attacks; Escape pauses.

ui.winMessage: You reached the ridge and claimed its relic.
ui.loseMessage: Restart from the menu and try a different route.
